abort_condition: Abort on any non-finite loss, gradient, logit, GAUC, or nDCG@5; use early stopping after 4 unimproved epochs, cap training at 40 epochs, and terminate the run if wall-clock time exceeds 120 seconds.
acceptance: Using validation data only, accept as the new champion if primary is at least 0.6037843061447144, GAUC is at least 0.6702978942871094, and nDCG@5 is at least 0.5366707776069641. This also remains above the organizer baseline plus epsilon. Otherwise reject.
change_summary: Train one seed-0 NumPy FM with positive_weight=2.75 instead of the champion's 2.5. Keep k=16, lr=0.001, epochs=40, batch_size=8192, patience=4, and all other behavior fixed.
hypothesis: Changing only the positive-example logistic-loss weight from 2.5 to 2.75 will increase KuaiRand-Pure long_view validation primary by at least 0.0001 relative to the current champion, without reducing either GAUC or nDCG@5 by more than 0.0002.
rationale: The observed seed-0 result improved from primary 0.6034932136535645 at positive_weight=2.0 to 0.6036843061447144 at 2.5. A single run at 2.75 is a low-cost local test of whether that upward trend continues, while avoiding the runtime risk of another multi-seed ensemble.
title: Refine champion positive weight from 2.5 to 2.75
